'''Darryll Silva''' (DeckTech author handle '''217'''; signs the post '''Shadow32''')<ref name="dt-22701">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/22701 DeckTech post 22701], DeckTech (Darryll "217" Silva, 9 April 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/22701/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/22701/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010110621/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/22701/ Wayback Machine].</ref> posted a [[Dark]] Hoth walker list on DeckTech in April 2002, crediting John Patchell's deck archetype.
